https://devforum.roblox.com/t/beta-intro.summary: Roblox Studio's AI Texture Generation feature added a "Quality" mode alongside the existing "Fast" mode, producing 4K PBR textures (color, roughness, metalness maps) in about 2 minutes versus Fast mode's 1K color-only output in about 30 seconds.

https://devforum.roblox.com/t/full-launc.name: Custom Terrain Materials (Roblox Studio/engine — full launch)
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/full-launc.summary: Roblox moved Custom Terrain Materials, letting creators define up to 62 paintable terrain materials, out of Early Access to full launch, alongside the first round of terrain rendering, storage and delivery performance improvements.

https://cloud.tencent.com/product/hunyua.name: Tencent Hunyuan 3D Cloud API — HY-3D 3.1 full pipeline (generation, rigging, retopology, texture, text-to-motion)
https://cloud.tencent.com/product/hunyua.summary: Tencent Cloud's Hunyuan product page lists hy-3d-3.1 (higher-precision successor to hy-3d-3.0) plus a self-serve API suite covering 3D generation, rigging, retopology, texturing, UV unwrapping, part/format conversion, and text-to-3D-character-motion (HY-3D-Motion, FBX output), distinct from the consumer 3d.hunyuan.tencent.com site. No explicit launch-announcement or pricing was found; dates are inferred from docs 'last updated' timestamps (2026-09-09 to 2026-09-29).

https://github.com/NVIDIAGameWorks/rtx-r.name: RTX Remix 1.6.1 — DLSS 5 3D-Guided Neural Rendering in the modding toolkit
https://github.com/NVIDIAGameWorks/rtx-r.summary: NVIDIA shipped RTX Remix 1.6.1, bringing DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering, a beta Frame Generation performance preset, 5x/6x Multi Frame Generation and ComfyUI 2.0 into the RTX Remix modding toolkit, plus Windows-on-ARM support.

updates.change: NVIDIA's GeForce News writeup of the RTX Remix 1.6 release (https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/news/remix-1-6-dlss-5-comfyui-2-0-minecraft-rtx-beta/) adds a flagship-game integration not previously logged: an open-source beta rendering Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.1 with DLSS-accelerated full path tracing, RTX Dynamic/Global Illumination, volumetric lighting, caustics and subsurface scattering (sample world by Blockworks, NVIDIA PBR materials pack), plus Multi Frame Generation extended to up to 6X.

https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/new.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 — DLSS 4.5 at launch (plus Cyberpunk 2077 upgrade)
https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/new.summary: NVIDIA states Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 ships with the full DLSS 4.5 feature set at its October 23 full launch, alongside a Cyberpunk 2077 update moving its DLSS integrations to DLSS 4.5's second-generation transformer models and DLSS 4.5 added to Planet Zoo 2.

https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacSim/re.name: Isaac Sim 6.2.0 (General Availability)
https://github.com/isaac-sim/IsaacSim/re.summary: NVIDIA shipped Isaac Sim 6.2.0 as a full GA release, upgrading its Kit SDK to 110.4.0 and Newton physics engine to 1.6.1, adding automatic AI-model selection for synthetic action/event data generation and deformable-object synthetic data with 3D bounding boxes.

https://docs.omniverse.nvidia.com/dev-gu.name: Omniverse Kit 110.4 — AI generative meshing from point clouds
https://docs.omniverse.nvidia.com/dev-gu.summary: NVIDIA shipped Omniverse Kit 110.4 with a new 'generative meshing' feature using AI models to turn point-cloud regions into textured 3D meshes, plus GPU-accelerated point-cloud-to-mesh conversion and DeepStream-powered GPU video textures.

https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2027.name: Maya 2027.2 — MotionMaker "Bring Your Own Data" custom motion-model training
https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2027.summary: Autodesk added "Bring Your Own Data" (BYOD) to MotionMaker in Maya 2027.2, letting users train custom machine-learning motion-generation models from their own animation/mocap data.

https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia.name: NVIDIA ACE — Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B (4GB) via the In-Game Inferencing (IGI) SDK
https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia.summary: NVIDIA states Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, an on-device LLM "purpose-built to power richer, faster in-game character interactions," is now available to developers via the In-Game Inferencing (IGI) SDK, running locally on GeForce RTX and RTX Spark with ~40% higher quality than its prior model, multi-turn tool use, and a 64k context window.

https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/.name: Tripo 3D pipeline tools on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Segmentation, SmartSegmentation, MeshCompletion, Retopology, ConvertFormat, RigCheck, AutoRig, AnimationRetarget, ImageToSplat, Texture)
https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/.company: Alibaba Cloud (Model Studio) — flagged: underlying models built by Tripo/VAST, not itself a tracked company
https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/.summary: Alibaba's Model Studio catalog added ten new Tripo-branded 3D-pipeline tools (segmentation, mesh completion, retopology, format conversion, rig-compatibility checking, AutoRig based on the UniRig algorithm, animation retargeting against 100 preset animations, image-to-Gaussian-splat, and automatic PBR texturing), extending Tripo's base generation models (on the catalog since 2026-04-27) into a fuller generate-to-animate pipeline.

https://devforum.roblox.com/t/upgrading-.name: Roblox Studio — Upgraded Shapecasts (Margins, Size Gradients, overrides)
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/upgrading-.summary: Roblox shipped a rewritten shapecast implementation (Blockcast/Spherecast/Shapecast) adding Margin and SizeGradient parameters plus CFrame/size overrides and in-Studio visualization; existing calls automatically run on the new implementation, which Roblox states is "up to 4.1x quicker" with no code changes required.

https://devforum.roblox.com/t/improving-.name: Roblox Studio — UGC Validation Visualization (avatar body/mesh quality checks)
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/improving-.summary: Roblox added a Studio tool visualizing UGC Marketplace validation errors/warnings directly on a selected 3D avatar asset (bodies, heads, layered clothing, rigid accessories), plus Asset Quality info on attachment placement, mesh structure, geometry integrity and vertex similarity; Roblox states it does not measure realism.

https://devforum.roblox.com/t/early-acce.name: Roblox AnimatedImages (2D sprite/character animation system)
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/early-acce.summary: Roblox opened an Early Access Program for AnimatedImages, a frame-based 2D animation system (AnimatedImage asset type, Aseprite import, AnimationPlayer, AnimatedImageService), limited to selected creators in Studio only; "you cannot publish places with these features yet."

https://devforum.roblox.com/t/studio-bet.name: Roblox Studio — Prompt-to-Avatar (Generate Game Characters)
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/studio-bet.summary: Roblox shipped a beta Avatar Setup tool that generates a full Roblox-ready 3D character model from a text prompt: a creator describes a character, refines a generated 2D concept image, then builds the 3D model with a choice of built-in clothing or a bare body, static or dynamic head, and R15 or Advanced R15 rig.
